keyFindings.text: **An independent, fixture-derived holdout already exists and has the recommended shape.** `holdout-prompts.jsonl` holds 66 frozen rows assembled from three separately-authored fixtures: `harder-intent-prompt-corpus.ts` (20 rows), `skill-advisor-regression-cases.jsonl` (40 rows), and `executor-delegation-cases.json` (6 rows). Every row's label is copied from its source fixture's own expected field — the builder states no gold is invented — and per-row provenance is preserved through `source_type` and `origin_fixture` fields so the set is auditable.
